snippet.title: Misc. A Tiny Tale - Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Misc. A Tiny Tale is OUT NOW on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
Buy Misc. A Tiny Tale on Steam & leave a review!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1308940/Misc_A_Tiny_Tale/
Buy on Nintendo eShop (U.S):
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/misc-a-tiny-tale-switch/
Buy on Nintendo eShop (U.K):
https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Misc-A-Tiny-Tale-2845634.html
Buy on Nintendo eShop (Aus):
https://ec.nintendo.com/AU/en/titles/70010000039111

Thank you all from the bottom of my heart for your support, kindness, and love over this wild journey. Thanks to each and every developer, big and small, who helped make this game possible. Thank you to Screenwest and Screen Australia for supporting and funding our game.

Meet Buddy and Bag Boy - two tiny robots with big hearts and an even bigger mission: spreading joy wherever they go! After a mysterious explosion rains golden cogs and trash from the sky, the duo must work together to restore each village and uncover the secret behind the blast. Scrub mess, collect trash, and lend a helping hand as you explore a familiar world from a tiny perspective.
Beneath the surface lies a touching tale that deepens as you meet new bots. From UFOs and secret lovers to unlikely heroes and dancing instruments, you’ll discover a world full of quirky characters with stories worth hearing.

- Explore backyards, playgrounds, and forgotten areas in a mysterious post-human world.
- Clean, repair, and make a meaningful difference in each area you visit.
- Interact with lovable robots made from everyday items, helping them with their struggles.
- Find golden cogs, coins, and hidden treasures tucked away in every nook and cranny.
- Experience a heartfelt narrative that mixes humor with real emotion.

Release Date: OUT NOW on Steam and Nintendo Switch.
(Nintendo Switch 2 backwards compatible)

Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Zw3UqMrB4b
Follow us on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/miscatinytale.bsky.social
Follow us on X: https://x.com/miscatinytale
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tinywaregames/
Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1RkbvhYW-wAtr3stpoidV9X_wJJMdVeP3
